translations.web: I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?
translations.bsb: And for the sake of your souls, I will most gladly spend my money and myself. If I love you more, will you love me less?
translations.kjv: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you; though the more abundantly I love you, the less I be loved.
translations.asv: And I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?
